description: A ratio calculator: reduce to lowest terms, or find the missing number. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

left.description: The left side of the ratio, the a in a:b. Decimals are allowed and are scaled to whole numbers before reducing, so 2.5:1 simplifies to 5:2 rather than rounding to 3:1.

right.description: The right side of the ratio, the b in a:b. A zero side is refused as not a ratio.

scaleTo.description: A new left-hand value to solve for: given, the answer is the c in a:b = scaleTo:c, returned as solved.value with a whole flag, since 16:9 at 1000 wide is 562.5 and is not rounded. Omitted, the ratio is only simplified.

name: ratio_calculator
title: Ratio Calculator
